length_over_HH.cause: calibration: W1 MF-human L 6.4 already realizes 0.28-0.30 HH (Marchfolk auricle 0.24); L also drives upward extension (+0.41 SD / +0.6 cm) and free lobe (+0.69)

width_over_length.cause: taper start / early taper narrows the upper ear; width also coupled to concha depth (+0.45), root flare phi0 (-8 deg: +0.42) and placement height (+0.55)

projection_deg.cause: calibration: W1 human proj 22 realizes ~23-25 deg vs the flat Marchfolk auricle 6.5 deg; projection itself is NOT linked to root rotation (phi0 / tauA < 0.07 SD)

upward_ext_over_HH.cause: the junction-centred placement puts every branch auricle top ~1.9 cm above the root-loop top (Marchfolk 0.3 cm); length and tilt add (+0.41, +0.32)

backward_angle_deg.cause: calibration: W1 human tilt 12 realizes ~14 deg (Marchfolk 4.8); sweep is a second backward driver (-0.4: -0.47 SD) -> tilt + sweep add

tip_angle_deg.cause: early continuous taper (start 0.36) makes an elf apex (60 deg) whatever the exponent (tex: -0.12 SD per +0.25); only a later start + shoulder rounds it

lobe_fraction.cause: the lobe parameter is inert in the realized free lobe (0.0 SD); the free lobe follows length (+0.69) and placement height (+1.15)

root_line_deg.cause: attachment-line inclination is set by the junction placement (place_du +2.5, place_db +1.3) and concha depth (-1.7); Marchfolk / elf differences small

concha_depth_over_L.cause: the authored concha 0.86 is diluted by the longer ear (depth / L) and the -0.50 seat; +0.25 concha -> +0.87 SD, but concha depth also raises the junction (mound)

tragus_height_frac.cause: cavum level falls as the upper extension lengthens (cavum stays at the base)

helix_fullness.cause: early taper start removes the upper helix body; sweep / tilt / shoulder restore it (+0.82 / +0.61 / +0.29)
